name: James Cook University
access: public_html; Pivot-RP/JCU network or account for personalised searches
eligibility_scope: JCU researcher and institutional endorsement rules
policy_note: JCU's current application-procedures guidance requires applicants to lodge at least one week before Australian-funder internal deadlines and two weeks before overseas-funder internal deadlines; internal dates allow checking and processing. The catalogue retains the existing scheme-specific NHMRC/ARC four-week value as a separately qualified planning input.

name: The University of Queensland
access: public_html; Grant Hub/MyResearch workflow may require UQ access
eligibility_scope: UQ internal close, external close and scheme-specific Research Office rules
policy_note: UQ publishes internal and external close dates; standard Research Office close is ten working days, with some ARC/NHMRC/MRFF schemes up to four weeks.

name: Queensland University of Technology
access: public page or institutional research-office route to be confirmed
eligibility_scope: QUT affiliation and internal research-office rules must be confirmed
policy_note: Public QUT research/ARC guidance was rechecked; internal deadlines remain Research Office-controlled and no lead-time policy was promoted.

name: Griffith University
access: public overview; Research Funding support is internal access only
eligibility_scope: Griffith researcher, coversheet and internal-grant rules
policy_note: Current public page confirms competitive-grant pre-award support and directs researchers to the internal Research Funding staff service area; it does not expose a universal lead-time rule or public feed, so lead time remains unknown.
